logins.title: External sign-in services
logins.none: Your account has no external sign-in service.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: An API key lets a script or another application use the Reliquary API for you. Each key has a daily quota. Keep your keys secret.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key "{{name}}"? The applications that use it stop working.
apiKeys.createdOnce: The key "{{name}}" is ready. Copy it now: the application shows it one time only.

dataExport.title: Export your data
dataExport.description: Get all the data of your account in a ZIP archive. The archive contains your account, your decks in text and JSON files, your folders, your tags, your favorites and the authors that you follow. It stays available for 7 days.
dataExport.pending: The server prepares the archive. Come back in a few minutes.

status.failed: Failed. Ask for a new export.

deletion.title: Delete your account
deletion.description: Reliquary deletes your account and all your data 7 days after your request. You can cancel the request during these 7 days. Export your data first if you want to keep it.
deletion.confirm: Delete your account and all your data in 7 days?
deletion.scheduled: Reliquary deletes your account and all your data on {{date}}.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.description: A delegation lets a module of this instance act for you, with the permissions that you choose, until a date. Revoke a delegation when you do not want the module to act for you.
delegations.noServiceAccount: No module of this instance can receive a delegation.
delegations.revokeConfirm: Revoke the delegation to "{{name}}"? The module stops acting for you immediately.
delegations.created: The module "{{name}}" can now act for you until {{date}}.

scope.decks_read: Read your decks, folders and tags
scope.decks_write: Create, change and delete your decks, folders and tags
scope.profile_read: Read your account: email address, name and language

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Plugins add functions to Reliquary. Each plugin runs in a sandbox and gets only the access that you accept.

state.paused: Paused. The new version asks for more access. Read the new access to start the plugin again.
state.disabledByCore: Reliquary deactivated this plugin on {{date}}, because it failed too many times. You can activate it again.

layout.title: Layout of {{name}}
layout.positionHint: The elements of a plugin with a smaller number come first. The default is 0.
layout.none: The plugin has no element that you can hide now.

consent.title: Activate {{name}}
consent.intro: Read the access that the plugin {{name}} (version {{version}}) asks for. The plugin gets only this access.
consent.updateIntro: You accepted the version {{accepted}} of {{name}}. The version {{version}} asks for the access below in addition. The plugin stays paused until you accept this access.
consent.nothing: The plugin asks for no access to your data, to other sites or to your devices.
consent.network: Sites that the plugin can contact
consent.networkHint: The plugin can send data to these sites and receive data from them.
consent.subdomains: All the sites of the domain {{host}}
consent.computerPort: A program on your computer, on the port {{port}}
consent.loopbackNetwork: The programs on your computer, through the local network
consent.site: Link your account of the site {{site}}

developmentPlugins.title: Development plugins
developmentPlugins.description: This instance is a development instance. You can load a plugin from the URL of its plugin manifest, for example the Vite server of the plugin. The plugin runs in a sandbox, but nobody reviewed it. Load only your own plugins.
developmentPlugins.loaded: The plugin "{{name}}" runs now in this browser.

errors.invalidUrl: The URL is not correct. Enter an absolute http or https URL.
errors.duplicate: The list already contains this URL.
errors.notAvailable: The plugin manifest did not load. Make sure that the server of the plugin runs and accepts requests from this site (CORS).
errors.missingFields: The plugin manifest does not have the fields "id", "version" and "entry". Add these fields to the plugin manifest.
errors.invalidEntry: The field "entry" of the plugin manifest is not an http or https URL. Change the field "entry".

linkedAccounts.title: Linked accounts
linkedAccounts.description: Your plugins use these accounts on other sites. Reliquary encrypts each API key, and only the plugin of the link can read it.
linkedAccounts.pluginInactive: The plugin does not run. You can only unlink the account.
linkedAccounts.unlinkConfirm: Unlink your account on {{site}}? Reliquary deletes the link and its API key.
linkedAccounts.oauthLater: This sign-in method is not available yet.
linkedAccounts.apiKeyHint: Reliquary encrypts the key. Only the plugin of the link can read it. The page never shows it again.
linkedAccounts.userNameHint: Your public user name on the site. The plugin reads only your public data.
